_about: What PULSAR can do on the HUD, described for the model that picks one when the astronaut's words match no fixed phrase (backend/pulsar/hud_skill.py). `when` says in plain words which requests belong to the action, `examples` are phrases in Spanish and English, `cues` are the words that make a request worth asking the model about at all (it is not asked about anything else). `say` and `name` point into pulsar/hud_actions.py. Add an action here and it is offered to the model; the HUD side must handle its `action`.

relax_breathe.when: The astronaut wants to calm down, lower stress, anxiety, nerves or worry, slow down, wind down or breathe. Slow guided breathing.
relax_breathe.name: breathe

relax_eyes.when: The astronaut's eyes are tired, dry, sore or strained, from looking at screens or for a long time. Rest the eyes.
examples: I need to rest my eyes
relax_eyes.name: eyes

relax_body.when: The astronaut feels muscle tension or stiffness in the neck, shoulders, back, jaw, arms or hands, or wants to stretch or let the tension go. Body relaxation.
relax_body.name: body

relax_menu.when: The astronaut wants to relax, take a break or a pause, rest, disconnect or switch off, with no preference for which exercise. Opens the relaxation menu so they pick.

measure_form.when: The astronaut wants to type in or log measurements in general, without naming which one.
examples: I want to log my readings

measure_heart.when: The astronaut asks how or where to take their pulse or heart rate, or wants that measurement panel.
examples: how do I check my pulse
measure_heart.name: biometrics.heartRateBpm

measure_pressure.when: The astronaut asks how or where to take their blood pressure, or wants that measurement panel. Not for muscle tension.
examples: how do I take my blood pressure
measure_pressure.name: selfReport.bloodPressure

measure_glucose.when: The astronaut asks about blood sugar or glucose, or how to measure it.
measure_glucose.name: selfReport.glucoseMgDl

measure_temperature.when: The astronaut asks about body temperature or fever, or how to take it.
measure_temperature.name: selfReport.bodyTempC

measure_sleep.when: The astronaut asks about their sleep, hours slept, or how to log it.
measure_sleep.name: selfReport.sleepHoursLast24h

measure_mood.when: The astronaut wants to log or check their mood or how they feel emotionally.
measure_mood.name: selfReport.mood

habits_open.when: The astronaut wants to see their daily habits panel: exercise, water, sleep and relaxation of today.

habits_history.when: The astronaut wants the history, the month view or the charts of their habits.

close_panels.when: The astronaut wants to close, hide or clear the open windows and panels.

lang_en.when: The astronaut wants the screen and PULSAR's voice in English.

lang_es.when: The astronaut wants the screen and PULSAR's voice in Spanish.

dev_open.when: The astronaut wants the developer, debug or settings menu open.

dev_close.when: The astronaut wants the developer, debug or settings menu closed.

mesh_on.when: The astronaut wants the face mesh drawn over the camera.
mesh_on.name: mesh

mesh_off.when: The astronaut wants the face mesh hidden.
mesh_off.name: mesh

ai_check_on.when: The astronaut wants the AI cross-check of the camera measurements switched on.
ai_check_on.name: ai_check

ai_check_off.when: The astronaut wants the AI cross-check of the camera measurements switched off.
ai_check_off.name: ai_check

health_head.when: The astronaut asks what could be wrong with, or what to do about, the head, the mind, headaches or thinking: opens that body zone's symptoms and what-to-do panel.
health_head.name: head

health_eyes.when: The astronaut asks what could be wrong with, or what to do about, the eyes or sight: opens that body zone's symptoms and what-to-do panel.
health_eyes.name: eyes_health

health_heart.when: The astronaut asks what could be wrong with, or what to do about, the heart or circulation: opens that body zone's symptoms and what-to-do panel.
health_heart.name: heart

health_lungs.when: The astronaut asks what could be wrong with, or what to do about, the lungs or breathing difficulty: opens that body zone's symptoms and what-to-do panel.
health_lungs.name: lungs

health_gut.when: The astronaut asks what could be wrong with, or what to do about, the stomach or digestion: opens that body zone's symptoms and what-to-do panel.
health_gut.name: gut

health_skin.when: The astronaut asks what could be wrong with, or what to do about, the skin: opens that body zone's symptoms and what-to-do panel.
health_skin.name: skin

health_hands.when: The astronaut asks what could be wrong with, or what to do about, the hands: opens that body zone's symptoms and what-to-do panel.
health_hands.name: hands

health_spine.when: The astronaut asks what could be wrong with, or what to do about, the spine or back: opens that body zone's symptoms and what-to-do panel.
health_spine.name: spine

health_legs.when: The astronaut asks what could be wrong with, or what to do about, the legs: opens that body zone's symptoms and what-to-do panel.
health_legs.name: legs

log_exercise.when: The astronaut says they did some exercise or workout; the number is the minutes (write hours as minutes).
examples: he hecho media hora de pesas
log_exercise.name: exercise

log_water.when: The astronaut says they drank water; the number is the glasses.
examples: I had two glasses of water
log_water.name: water

log_relax.when: The astronaut says they did a relaxation or breathing session; the number is the sessions.
examples: he hecho una sesión de relajación
log_relax.name: relax

set_heartRateBpm.when: The astronaut tells you a value to type in: heart rate in beats per minute. Write the id then the number(s) in that order.
set_heartRateBpm.name: biometrics.heartRateBpm

set_bloodPressure.when: The astronaut tells you a value to type in: blood pressure: top number then bottom number. Write the id then the number(s) in that order.
set_bloodPressure.name: selfReport.bloodPressure

set_glucoseMgDl.when: The astronaut tells you a value to type in: glucose in mg/dL. Write the id then the number(s) in that order.
set_glucoseMgDl.name: selfReport.glucoseMgDl

set_bodyTempC.when: The astronaut tells you a value to type in: body temperature in degrees Celsius. Write the id then the number(s) in that order.
set_bodyTempC.name: selfReport.bodyTempC

set_sleepHoursLast24h.when: The astronaut tells you a value to type in: hours slept in the last 24 hours. Write the id then the number(s) in that order.
set_sleepHoursLast24h.name: selfReport.sleepHoursLast24h

set_mood.when: The astronaut tells you a value to type in: mood from 1 to 5. Write the id then the number(s) in that order.
set_mood.name: selfReport.mood
